explanation: Green's Problem 44 (Erdős): remove ⌊p_i/2⌋ residue classes mod each of 1000 primes p₁ < ⋯ < p₁₀₀₀ < N^{9/10}; is the remainder ≤ N/10? The bound p₁₀₀₀ < N^{9/10} is encoded exactly as p^10 < N^9, and "half the residue classes" is read as ⌊p/2⌋, as documented. The statement quantifies over all N, which is equivalent here, since the constraints force N to be very large anyway. The statement is faithful.
